title: Implement IHAVE bulk import tool (push mode)
description:
Implement a CLI tool (or transit subcommand) that reads articles from a directory or stdin and sends them to a running transit daemon via IHAVE/TAKETHIS. Supports batch mode: send N articles in parallel. Reports progress: articles sent, articles rejected (duplicate/malformed), elapsed time. Artifact: transit/src/import/ihave_push.rs and a CLI entry point.

Acceptance:
- Successfully imports a 1000-article corpus in a single run
- Duplicate articles (already known Message-ID) are counted and skipped without error
- Malformed articles (missing mandatory header) are logged with filename and skipped
- Final report: total sent, accepted, rejected, duplicates
- --parallel N flag controls concurrency (default 4)
